arguments.value: MediaCo Holding Inc. and WBLS-WLIB LLC entered into an agreement dated November 25, 2019, under which MediaCo, as the licensee and operator of WQHT-FM in New York, agreed to carry WBLS-WLIB LLC’s WLIB-AM programming on WQHT-FM’s HD2 digital channel. WBLS-WLIB LLC may simulcast WLIB programming on the HD2 channel except from 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 a.m. on Sundays, and it must deliver the programming at its own cost and meet technical standards. MediaCo keeps full control over station operations, FCC compliance, and the right to reject, edit, or preempt programming when required by public interest, FCC rules, emergencies, or legal concerns. WBLS-WLIB LLC must handle music licenses, production and delivery costs, and compliance support for political advertising rules, while MediaCo does not pay it any fee and WBLS-WLIB LLC may not separately sell advertising, though it may market the rebroadcast. The agreement runs until the earliest of December 31, 2022, termination of the related studio lease, termination by WBLS-WLIB LLC, or mutual written agreement, and either party may terminate for uncured material default after notice and a 15-day cure period. WBLS-WLIB LLC must indemnify MediaCo for claims arising from the programming. The agreement states that Indiana law governs.
